scripts.build: rm -rf dist && cp -r public dist && esbuild src/background.ts src/content.ts src/popup.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --define:__KITSUNE_LIVE__=false
scripts.build:live: rm -rf dist && cp -r public dist && esbuild src/background.ts src/content.ts src/popup.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --define:__KITSUNE_LIVE__=true
scripts.watch: rm -rf dist && cp -r public dist && esbuild src/background.ts src/content.ts src/popup.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --define:__KITSUNE_LIVE__=false --watch
